description: This file defines a React Native functional component named ControlPad, along with some internal hooks and subcomponents, used to render and handle input controls for a Tetris game interface. It manages button press interactions, including repeated actions (like moving left/right/down) and controls for game actions such as rotate, drop, pause, and resume.

methods.name: useRepeater
methods.description: A custom React hook that manages repeated invocation of a function with specified initial delay and repeat interval, typically used for continuous movement in game controls.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A React component that renders a styled pressable button with different variants and accessibility features, used for control inputs.
